name: Exp_RSIOMA_V2
summary: This EA trades based on the RSIOMA_V2 indicator, which is a smoothed RSI with momentum. It supports three signal modes: level breakout, histogram direction change, and signal cloud color change. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSIOMA_V2指标进行交易，该指标是带有动量的平滑RSI。支持三种信号模式：水平突破、柱状图方向变化和信号云颜色变化。根据这些动量信号进行开平仓，并可配置资金管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于RSIOMA_V2指标，这是一个对RSI进行双重平滑处理并加入动量计算的指标。策略提供三种入场模式：第一种是水平突破模式，当RSIOMA值从下方突破上触发线（默认60）时做多，从上方跌破下触发线（默认40）时做空；第二种是方向变化模式，当RSIOMA柱状图方向由下转上时做多，由上转下时做空；第三种是信号云变色模式，当上轨云线穿越下轨云线时产生信号。出场条件包括止损止盈以及反向信号平仓，止损默认1000点，止盈默认2000点。仓位管理支持固定手数或按存款比例计算，通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制。资金管理允许负值MM参数表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例分配。EA仅在新区块出现时计算信号，避免重复交易，同时使用全局变量管理交易状态。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RSIOMA_V2 indicator, which applies double smoothing to RSI and incorporates momentum calculation. The strategy offers three entry modes: first, the breakdown mode goes long when RSIOMA crosses above the upper trigger level (default 60) and goes short when it crosses below the lower trigger level (default 40); second, the twist mode enters long when the RSIOMA histogram direction changes from down to up and short when it reverses; third, the cloudtwist mode generates signals when the upper cloud line crosses the lower cloud line. Exit conditions include stop-loss and take-profit (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively) as well as counter-signal closes. Position sizing supports either fixed lot size or deposit-proportional calculation controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration. Money management allows negative MM values for fixed lots and positive values for deposit-proportional allocation. The EA only recalculates signals on new bars to avoid redundant trades, and uses global variables to manage trading state across ticks.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lot or percentage)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：水平突破/方向变化/云变色

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 提供三种灵活的入场信号模式，适应不同市场环境
使用双重平滑RSI指标，信号质量优于普通RSI
具备完整的多空开平仓权限控制，策略灵活性高
仅在新区块时计算信号，避免频繁交易和重复信号
pros_en: Offers three flexible entry signal modes suitable for different market conditions
Uses double-smoothed RSI indicator producing higher quality signals than standard RSI
Provides complete buy/sell open/close permission controls for strategy flexibility
Only calculates signals on new bars, avoiding frequent trading and duplicate signals
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能导致较大回撤
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在不利条件下可能产生亏损交易
没有追踪止损功能，浮盈可能大幅回撤后才止盈
依赖自定义指标RSIOMA_V2，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are very wide, potentially causing large drawdowns
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may generate losing trades under unfavorable conditions
No trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may give back significant gains before hitting TP
Depends on the custom RSIOMA_V2 indicator, EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和非活跃时段交易
添加追踪止损功能以保护浮盈，减少盈利回撤
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high spread and inactive periods
Add trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits and reduce profit givebacks

risk_points: 默认止损点数过大（1000点），单笔交易亏损风险较高
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
资金管理参数MM为负值时为固定手数，缺乏最大手数限制保护
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss is very wide (1000 points), single trade loss risk is significant
No spread filter, may execute unfavorable trades in high-spread environments
When MM is negative (fixed lot mode), there is no maximum lot size protection
